Toy Cone on Hemisphere, surface areas, Class 10 board exam: radius 3.5 cm, total height 15.5 cm. Find the total surface area.

• Only curved surfaces: TSA = 2πr² + πrl
• Cone height 12 cm, slant height √(144 + 12.25) = 12.5 cm
• πr(2r + l) = (22/7)(3.5)(19.5) = 214.5 cm²
